purpose: Mandatory pre-training validation gates that any candidate V6 dataset must pass BEFORE any model training is permitted.

observable_signature_recurrence.rationale: Prevents combinatorial signature explosion and ensures meaningful historical behavioral neighborhoods exist.

observable_dominant_cluster_concentratio.rationale: Ensures that similar cases have a clear probabilistic preference while avoiding deterministic over-concentration.

neighbor_top1_cluster_purity.rationale: Ensures pre-event observables possess non-random spatial locality signal.

neighbor_top3_cluster_purity.rationale: Confirms observable feature neighborhoods reliably span the true cash-out cluster.

district_predictability_top1.rationale: Verifies that multi-account and money flow trajectories provide learnable district routing signal.

cross_district_predictability.rationale: Directly targets the primary failure mode identified in V5 where cross-district cases collapsed to 19%.

target_cluster_entropy.rationale: Ensures all 60 operational clusters are actively utilized and prevents mode collapse into trivial hubs.

max_nearest_origin_rate_pct.rationale: Guarantees distance baseline does not trivially win.

max_terminal_mule_match_rate_pct.rationale: Ensures terminal mule account location does not deterministically encode target.

max_fraud_type_target_dominance_pct.rationale: Prevents single fraud category from collapsing into a fixed cluster.

enforcement_action: If any pre-training gate fails on candidate V6 dataset, training must NOT commence. Generator logic must be revised and re-audited.
